purpose: Convert promising synthetic mechanism findings into defensible theory claims by testing distributional closure, genuine held-out reduced-model fidelity, structural phase boundaries, and invariance without historical tuning.
claims_explicitly_not_yet_licensed: exact or approximate Markov sufficiency of (M,F,E,C)
Gamma as a universal territorial-control order parameter
95 percent continuous trajectory fidelity of the 15-parameter ODE

distributional_closure.design: Hold initialization_seed and locality fixed, generate distinct dynamic microstates with different process seeds, greedily select near-matched same-locality states, then rekey both inherited full states to identical future RNG branch panels.

pair_stratification.activity_score: M + E + log1p(F)/(1+log1p(F)); monotone bounded composite using only pre-continuation activity variables
pair_stratification.low_mid_high: rank tertiles of activity_score in the pre-continuation candidate pool; deterministic rank tie-breaking may split exact ties so each activity band remains populated
pair_stratification.allocation: approximately equal pair counts per low/mid/high activity tertile, with best remaining near-matches used only if a tertile is exhausted

distributional_closure.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg q <= 0.05 over pair-outcome tests within each candidate/horizon assay.
distributional_closure.pass_gate: At most 10 percent of matched pairs may contain any multiplicity-significant practically large primary-outcome difference overall, and no activity stratum may exceed 20 percent. Report raw practical-large rates separately. Passing licenses approximate closure only over tested synthetic context/horizons.
distributional_closure.amendment_note: An exploratory minimal4 run was already in flight when audit identified two preregistration omissions: the reduced theory itself includes global K_o, and unconstrained nearest-neighbor matching can overselect dormant localities. A subsequent 6-pair smoke test showed the original fixed activity cutoffs left the intermediate stratum empty, so the official design uses outcome-blind pre-continuation activity tertiles. Neither exploratory run is used as the official gate. This amendment was frozen before any official 24-pair result was observed.

reduced_model_validation.rule: Derive/fix equations and parameters on training regimes only, hash/freeze them, then evaluate untouched dynamic seeds, parameter cells, topologies, and intervention conditions.
required_metrics: continuous MAE and NRMSE for M,F,E,C
reduced_model_validation.forbidden_metric: Do not call an arithmetic mean of coarse classification accuracies trajectory fidelity.

phase_mapping.rule: Regimes and boundaries must be inferred from sampled outcomes rather than hand-coded from prior result summaries.
phase_mapping.bifurcation_labels: No named mathematical bifurcation is permitted without continuation/local-stability evidence supporting that bifurcation type.

promotion_rule: Only claims passing their corresponding v2 hardening assay may be promoted from candidate mechanism/hypothesis to robust synthetic law. Historical transport remains a later, separately frozen protocol.
